_how: Contact info + address are collected first by the hero form (partial lead saved). These questions run on /step-2/, one per screen. next = a question id, "@score" (add up points, pick a tier) or "@end:<ending id>" (stop now). force_tier pins the tier no matter the score.

questions.label: Is the house listed with a real estate agent right now?

options.label: It was, but the listing expired

questions.label: How long has it been listed?
What type of property is it?
Do you own the land the home sits on?

options.label: No, it's in a park or leased lot

questions.label: Are you the owner on the title, or legally able to decide to sell?

options.label: Yes, I'm the owner on the title
Yes, I'm a legal decision-maker (co-owner, heir, POA)

questions.label: How soon do you need to sell?
What's going on with the house?
Tell us a little about it (optional)

hot.headline: You're a great fit. Expect a call in the next few minutes.
hot.body: Keep your phone close. Want to go faster? Call us now.

warm.headline: Thanks! We'll call you today.
warm.body: We review every property by hand and will reach out shortly.

nurture.headline: Thanks! We've got your info.
nurture.body: We'll check in with options that fit your timeline. No pressure.

not_fit.headline: Thanks for the details.
not_fit.body: This one may not be a fit for us right now, but we saved your info and will reach out if anything changes.
